definitions.explanation: Surgery to improve or restore appearance.
Medical treatment of the musculoskeletal system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧{整形|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{整形|せいけい}⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。

notes:
{整形|せいけい} has two related but distinct meanings, both involving reshaping or correcting the body.

SENSE 1 - COSMETIC SURGERY:
Refers to surgery performed to improve appearance. Often used casually to mean 'getting work done.'
- ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧{整形|せいけい} (cosmetic/aesthetic surgery)
- {整形|せいけい}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ (plastic surgery operation)
- {整形|せいけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have plastic surgery)

SENSE 2 - ORTHOPEDICS:
Refers to the medical treatment of bones, joints, and muscles.
- {整形|せいけい}⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧ (orthopedic surgery department)
- {整形|せいけい}⟦{外科医|げかい}→外科医：21001_gekai⟧ (orthopedic surgeon)

DISAMBIGUATION:
In casual conversation, {整形|せいけい} alone usually implies cosmetic surgery. For orthopedics, the full compound {整形|せいけい}⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧ is typically used. Context usually clarifies the intended meaning.
